# Getinge

> > Global medtech leader providing solutions for operating rooms, intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, sterile reprocessing, and life science applications.

Getinge AB is a Swedish medical technology company delivering critical equipment and systems for healthcare facilities and pharmaceutical production worldwide. The company specializes in ventilation, ECMO, IABP therapy, hybrid OR systems, and sterile processing solutions with operations across Europe and global markets.

## Key Topics

- Medical technology and healthcare solutions
- Intensive care and mechanical ventilation
- IABP (Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump) therapy
- ECMO and cardiovascular procedures
- Operating room and hybrid OR systems
- Sterile reprocessing and infection control
- Life science and pharmaceutical production
- Cardiogenic shock treatment
- Respiratory support systems
- Hemodynamic monitoring (Pulsiocare)
- SCAI SHOCK Stage Classification
- Servo Ventilator technology
- Corporate governance and sustainability
- Swedish medtech innovation
- Getinge AB (parent company)

## Intensive Care Solutions

- [Mechanical ventilation solutions](https://www.getinge.com/int/products-and-solutions/intensive-care/mechanical-ventilation): Servo Ventilator and personalized ICU ventilation solutions
- [Getinge ECMO solutions](https://www.getinge.com/int/products-and-solutions/intensive-care/extracorporeal-membrane-oxygenation): ECMO and eCPR solutions for cardiac and respiratory failure support

## Operating Room Solutions

- [The Hybrid OR is the future of surgery](https://www.getinge.com/int/products-and-solutions/operating-room/hybrid-and-imaging-or): Hybrid OR solutions for image-guided multidisciplinary surgery
- [Advanced OR Patient Monitoring Solutions](https://www.getinge.com/int/products-and-solutions/operating-room/or-advanced-patient-monitoring): Pulsiocare hemodynamic monitoring for perioperative fluid management

## Cardiovascular Procedures

- [IABP first line support for your high risk patients](https://www.getinge.com/int/products-and-solutions/cardiovascular-procedures/iabp-counterpulsation): IABP therapy for cardiogenic shock and high-risk PCI procedures
